name: Danganronpa Dreamland -Bada-wa Gorae-ui Changa-
source:
The premise is as usual 15 students trapped in a school, Hope Peak Academy....or is it?

Either way,  get ready to meet new faces and wild personalities. 

[From [url=https://zephi.itch.io/danganronpa-dreamland]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
前提是像往常一样，15名学生被困在一所学校，希望之峰学园……或者是吗？

不管怎样，准备好迎接新面孔和狂野的人物吧。

[来自[url=https://zephi.itch.io/danganronpa-dreamland]Itch.io[/url]]
